market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from sticky CPI, two Fed hikes, oil above $100, and trade war escalation. S&P 500 likely range-bound 7,800-8,100 absent catalyst. Oil volatility dominates. Dollar whipsaws. Expect elevated VIX and bond yield volatility through Q4.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle and productivity gains support equity upside over 12 months, but inflation persistence and geopolitical risk cap multiples. Energy structural supply constraints (OPEC 1990 lows) support $90-110 oil range. Housing correction likely extends. Fed 'risk management hikes' create choppy but not recessionary path.
